info.description: ONE SECTION'S WEEKLY TIMETABLE, as an image of the school's own sheet. ⚠ THERE IS NO ALT FIELD ON PURPOSE — the page writes it from the class and the section ('The weekly timetable for Class I, section B, …'), so an editor uploading a replacement cannot leave a stale description behind, and cannot leave one blank. ⚠ DO NOT RETYPE A TIMETABLE INTO TEXT ANYWHERE. Each sheet carries teachers' names and a page of instructions; a transcription becomes a second version that goes stale the moment the school revises the original.

section.description: The section letter as the sheet prints it — A, B, C… Leave EMPTY where the class has one sheet and no section (Nursery).
